The best plan costs 282: two trips rescue 7 people, and 2 people must be deferred.

**Unreachable people:** Nilkantha temple and Suryagadhi market connect to the rest of the network only through the damaged Kalika–Nilkantha road. The 1 elderly person (50) and 1 adult (20) there must be deferred, for a fixed penalty of 70.

**Reachable people:** The only open route is shelter → Gajuri (19) → Kalika (19) → Syaphru (30). This makes a Kalika round trip 76 minutes and a Syaphru round trip 136 minutes. The car has 4 seats, and there are 7 people to move (6 elderly at Kalika and 1 injured at Syaphru).

| Option | Driving | Penalties | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Two trips, one reaching Syaphru, everyone rescued | 136 + 76 = 212 | 0 | **212** |
| Two Kalika trips, injured person deferred | 152 | 80 | 232 |
| One Kalika trip, 2 elderly and injured person deferred | 76 | 100 + 80 = 180 | 256 |
| One Syaphru trip, 3 elderly deferred | 136 | 150 | 286 |
| No trips, everyone deferred | 0 | 300 + 80 = 380 | 380 |

Two trips rescuing everyone is the cheapest option. Adding the fixed penalty of 70 gives a total of 212 + 70 = 282.
